offers.title: Moostar
offers.description:
Moostar is a UK bathroom brand built on a simple idea: the toilet brush hadn't really changed in decades, so we redesigned it.
Our flagship product, the Soap Push, is a 304 stainless steel toilet brush with a built-in soap reservoir.
One push dispenses cleaning liquid straight onto the brush, so every clean is quicker, fresher and more hygienic.

The Soap Push has been independently recognised with three approvals:

• Good Housekeeping Institute Approved 2026
• GoodHomes Approved
• woman&home Reader Approved

offers.title: Rugs Direct 2U
offers.description:
Rugs Direct 2U is a division of Carpets Direct 2U Ltd, a well established, family owned and run flooring specialist business based in the West Midlands.
Benefitting from four generations of retail experience, we have established a reputation for providing customers with good service and quality floor coverings priced to suit everyone's pocket.
We are one of the leading independent carpet and rug sellers in the UK and are trusted and respected by customers and suppliers alike.
We have rugs to suit all tastes and budgets from stunning retro designs to timeless classical styles from our traditional collection.
We offer a wide variety of colours, sizes and styles with materials ranging from luxurious wool to durable manmade fibres. 
We aim to provide quality rugs at competitive prices.
As an established retailer, we are able to negotiate discounts with our suppliers and pass on these savings to our customers.

offers.title: Sewing Online
offers.description:

The Last Word in Sewing Supplies

offers.title: Urban Bar
offers.description:
Urban Bar – Premium Glassware & Barware for Professionals and Enthusiasts
Urban Bar is a leading international provider of high-quality glassware and barware, serving the hospitality industry, top spirits brands, and consumers worldwide.
Established in 1983 by Richard Andrews, a former buyer for Liberty and Heals, Urban Bar has spent over four decades refining its craftsmanship to meet the highest standards of design, functionality, and durability.

What Makes Urban Bar Unique?

Premium Quality & Craftsmanship – Designed for professionals, tested for durability, and crafted to enhance the drinking experience.
Trusted by Global Brands – We collaborate with leading spirits companies and hospitality venues.
Bespoke & Branded Products – Custom glassware and bar tools for businesses looking to stand out.
Sustainable Approach – Focused on eco-friendly materials and long-lasting products.
Diverse Product Range – From cocktail shakers and strainers to elegant tumblers and gin balloons, we provide everything needed for a top-tier bar setup.

offers.title: Envie4u
offers.description:
Why Choose EnVie Lingerie?
EnVie Lingerie is a Multi Award  Winning Lingerie and Swimwear Specialist Website who has been in business for over 30 years. 

The business launched in 1997 manufacturing handmade lingerie as the Owner Jane Mills has an extensive fashion & design background which gives her extra skills and expertise when it comes to bra and swimwear fitting. 
She is also very passionate about post-surgery and mastectomy underwear as she has undergone a mastectomy and cancer treatment herself she is able to identify with her customers and offers a very special customer service like no other,
As well as an extensive range of lingerie and bra-sized swimwear, from EnVie also offer maternity and nursing bras fitting up to a K cup and specialist mastectomy swimwear and bras too. 
EnVie understand how difficult it can be for women who has had breast surgery to find a bra they are comfortable in with a perfect fit and also to feel relaxed and at one’s ease while discussing this. 
As the owner has gone through this process customers are able to relate and identify with her.

offers.title: The British Belt Company
offers.description:
We are a traditional belt manufacturer but the British Belt Company not only makes belts we also make a selection of braces, bags and small leather goods.
Our founder Arnold Wills, started the company in 1946, seeing the opportunities in Britain at the time.
With a passion for the centuries old traditions of leather working, he quickly built a reputation for the finest leather products, supplying to the most renowned stores of the time.

We now have a wide range of Men's and Ladies leather belts, braces and leather goods.
All our belts are handmade here in our factory in Rutland, England.
We have recently re-launched our website and are heading towards a more modern look while still sticking to our orginal country heritage roots.
We ship worldwide from our factory and warehouse here in Rutland.

offers.title: The Stencil Studio
offers.description:
The Stencil Studio is a UK company specialising in creating high-quality, unique stencils that are sold worldwide.

Established in 2008 by sisters Nikki & Clare, The Stencil Studio has grown from its humble beginnings of hand cutting stencils in a converted garage space to becoming one of the top stencil brands in the UK by investing in the latest high tech precision laser cutting machines.

Based in our studio in the Cotswolds, we offer a huge collection of stencil designs in a range of sizes to suit any home decorating, DIY, up-cycling or craft project. Our stencils are precision laser cut from a high quality 190 micron Mylar that is washable and reusable, making decorating your home with stencils very cost effective. Suitable for use on any type of surface from walls, tiles, furniture, fabric to patio slabs and scrapbooks.

We pride ourselves on providing quality customer service and are committed to creating innovative stencil designs that are attractive, creative, and long-lasting. We love to help our customers unlock their creativity and bring their visions to life.

offers.title: Skiworld
offers.description:
Skiworld are one of the largest ski holiday operators in the UK. We offer over 200 different accommodations in Europe and North America ranging from budget-conscious apartments to truly luxurious chalets and hotels. As a fully ABTA and ATOL bonded tour operator we package our holidays with flights and transportation to provide our customers with the peace of mind they deserve when going on holiday.
Looking at how far we have come over the last 40 years, we reflected on what makes Skiworld different from the other ski companies out there and keeps us all so passionate about what we do.  The answer was easy - we are truly a company run by skiers for skiers.
